title: Years after setup: close days, payment days, occurrences and statements are made as far as any question asks (decision X7, confirm_review_1 item 7)
story: Set up Fri 20 Nov 2026. The bank holds 300,000. A card closes on the 25th and is paid on the 10th of the next month (its last statement, closed 25 Oct 2026, was 0 and paid); a store card's close day is not sure and it is paid on the 27th; a credit line (a loan, owed 0) asks 10,000 on the 5th once drawn on; a pay-later account asks each plan's part on the 5th. All are paid from the bank, with no weekend move. Pay of 250,000 on the 15th (moved earlier) starts the period; rent of 80,000 on the 27th from Nov 2036, when the person moves (moved later); a yearly tax of 50,000 on 15 Mar from 2036 (moved later), paid from a tax place that refills. Food is 30,000 a month and Free to spend 60,000. In May 2029 the person spends 20,000 on the card and pays it on Mon 11 Jun 2029. In 2036 they pay the tax on Mon 17 Mar, check the bank on Sat 1 Nov (230,000), spend 10,000 on the store card on Mon 3 Nov, draw 100,000 on the credit line on Thu 6 Nov, buy 15,000 on pay later (three parts of 5,000 from Fri 5 Dec) on Mon 10 Nov, tick the pay on Fri 14 Nov, spend 20,000 on food on the card on Sun 16 Nov, get a 5,000 refund on it on Mon 17 Nov, and skip November's rent (waived) on Tue 18 Nov. Before X7 close days were made only 29 months past the opening statement and a not-sure card's payment days 40 months past the opening: the 2029 spend was never due and nothing on the store card was due after 2030. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 20,000 (spend Wed 2 May 2029, in the statement closed Fri 25 May 2029) = 20,000
asks.note: Before X7: no close day after early 2029, so this spend was never due.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 20,000 (the card statement closed 25 May 2029, paid Sun 10 Jun, before the pay of Fri 15 Jun) = 20,000

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 230,000 (check-in Sat 1 Nov 2036) + 100,000 (drawn on the credit line, Thu 6 Nov) + 250,000 (pay, Fri 14 Nov) = 580,000

asks.question: card_due
asks.note: The 2029 statement was paid; every statement since was 0. The statement closing Tue 25 Nov 2036 is paid Wed 10 Dec.

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 10,000 (spend Mon 3 Nov 2036; close day not sure, so everything owed is due on the next payment day) = 10,000
asks.note: Before X7 the store card had no payment day after March 2030.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 10,000 (store card, all owed, Thu 27 Nov) + 10,000 (credit line, Fri 5 Dec) + 5,000 (pay later, the first part, Fri 5 Dec) + 15,000 (card, still open, Wed 10 Dec) = 40,000
asks.note: November's rent was skipped (waived), so it is not due. The next pay is Mon 15 Dec 2036.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 580,000 (Bank today) - 10,000 (Food left this period: 30,000 - 20,000) - 10,000 (Store card, all owed, paid 27 Nov) - 10,000 (Credit line 5 Dec) - 5,000 (Pay later 5 Dec) - 15,000 (Card, still open, closes 25 Nov, paid 10 Dec) = 530,000

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend this period, from the pay of Fri 14 Nov 2036; the bank's headroom is larger) = 60,000

asks.question: place
asks.why: 0 (opening) + 0 (nothing set aside since the 2036 tax took what it held) = 0
asks.note: It refills: next due on the tax's next occurrence not settled, 15 Mar 2037.
